title: Spec: 08 GCP-3 Trust Models
description: Trust models for gateway federation: Closed Federation (PSK-based, OSCORE) and Open Federation (Ed25519 signatures, Schnorr, TOFU). Both modes MUST be implemented. See spec/08-gateway-coordination.md sections 3.1-3.2.
close_reason: Fixed: Python trust module was implemented but not exported from crypto/__init__.py. Added missing imports for TrustLevel, TrustStore, TrustEntry, TrustError, DerivationMismatchError, UnknownPeerError, RevokedPeerError, and oracle functions. Rust implementation in lichen-gateway/src/trust.rs is complete. All 42 Python trust tests pass (228 total crypto tests). Child issues can be individually assessed for closure.
